title: Scalar diquarks in the QCD vacuum
summary: While QCD fundamentally only depends on the values of the strong coupling and the quark masses, it exhibits a rich nonperturbative structure at low energies, where composite fields emerge as the relevant degrees of freedom. In this work, we present a first-principles framework that captures the transition from fundamental QCD to its low-energy sector in vacuum. It builds on the dynamical hadronization technique within the functional renormalization group approach to two-flavor QCD.
